title: Priest's Letter
wikitext:
The '''Priest's Letter''' is provided as an objective for {{questlong|Alliance|1|Priest's Letter (quest)|Priest's Letter|race=HighElf|class=priest}}.

==Contains==
{{Book|content=
Light be with you, <name>.

I am Maelah Sunsworn.

I was once ordained in Temples of Quel'Thalas where I learned to preach the Light of the Sun. I walked the same halls as High Priest Belo'vir.

It is with much sadness that those days are gone as our temples lay in ruin, and the warmth of the Sun is forsaken.

I have seen the spark of devotion and faith within you.

Come speak with me at the lodge. I will gladly guide your path so that, one day, our people's faith may be restored not only in the Light, but in our future.
}}
